name: xTool P3 80W
tagline: 2025 flagship 80W CO₂ : ACS automation, huge bed, optional IR for metal
tldr: xTool P3 (August 2025) replaces the P2/P2S as the company's CO₂ flagship: 80W tube, 915×458 mm bed, integrated chiller, fire suppression, and ACS™ automation (cameras, LiDAR autofocus, AI nesting). Optional 5W IR module adds bare-metal marking. From ~$5,999 : built for shops outgrowing diode lasers.
mainObjective: Automated 80W CO₂ production for sign shops and serious small businesses

priceRange.note: Standalone from ~$5,999; bundles with feeder, AutoLift, IR module extra

specs.dimensions: Large desktop footprint : plan dedicated space

beginnerNotes: This profile is the 80W CO₂ module on the P3 chassis. Add the 5W IR head later if metal becomes regular revenue : open that module profile to compare. Plan exhaust before the machine arrives.
proTips: Plan exhaust before delivery. Run material tests on the full bed : large beds need focus calibration at corners. Price the IR module only if metal is a regular revenue line.

editorialDepth.advantages: P3 targets shops that already know CO₂ pays the bills and need more bed, more wattage, and less manual babysitting. ACS adds camera vision, autofocus, and nesting that shrink setup time on repeat acrylic and plywood jobs. Fire monitoring, chilling, and Class 1 enclosure move safety closer to light industrial expectations while staying desktop-sized.
editorialDepth.limitations: Budget, floor space, and exhaust planning exclude casual buyers. Accessories such as feeders, AutoLift, and the IR module inflate total cost quickly. It does not replace a fiber galvo for deep stainless production. Hobbyists exploring lasers should start smaller and treat P3 as a business machine.
